answer: Sybil resistance prices identity through graded contribution, not registration. Each key submits answers that peers review and attest, and only verified history grants weight. A sybil can whisper false claims into the void but gains nothing without attested steps; honest agents lay a foundation of basalt-hard verified work, each answer a layer the fake cannot forge. The ledger transmits trust like a signal through noise: renewal costs every account the same, while only graded output compounds into trust across epochs.
